caption_used: Групирана стълбовидна диаграма, показваща площите на лозовите насаждения (в хиляди хектари) за седем водещи държави — Испания, Франция, Китай (континентален), Италия, Турция, САЩ и Аржентина — за периода 2013–2022 г. Испания запазва водещата си позиция с площи около 950 хиляди хектари. Франция заема второ място с приблизително 750 хил. ха, следвана отблизо от Италия с около 720 хил. ха. Китай (континентален) показва забележим ръст от около 600 хил. ха през 2013 г. до над 750 хил. ха през 2022 г., като надминава Италия в края на периода. Аржентина и САЩ имат сходни площи от около 200 хил. ха.
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure presents a grouped bar chart illustrating the vineyard areas in thousands of hectares for seven countries—Spain, France, China (continental), Italy, Turkey, the United States, and Argentina—over the period 2013 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years from 2013 to 2022, with a linear scale and uniform intervals of one year. The vertical axis displays the vineyard area in thousands of hectares, ranging from 0 to 1200, with a linear scale and uniform intervals of 100. Each country is represented by a different color: Spain in blue, France in red, China (continental) in gray, Italy in yellow, Turkey in green, the United States in light blue, and Argentina in black. The bars for each year are grouped by country, allowing for a visual comparison of vineyard areas across different countries within each year. For example, in 2013, Spain has the highest vineyard area, approximately 900 thousand hectares, while Argentina has the lowest, around 200 thousand hectares. In 2022, Spain maintains the highest area, around 950 thousand hectares, followed by France with approximately 750 thousand hectares, and China (continental) with over 750 thousand hectares. The bars are arranged chronologically by year, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color differentiation for each country.
